instruction: A candid documentary wide shot from a slightly high angle shows an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands in profile, facing right. On the right, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing left, extending her right arm to touch the man (R1)'s chest. The two interact in the center of the room under bright overhead fluorescent lighting, which casts soft shadows on the neutral-colored walls and the prominent red floor.
